'''Arachnes''' were [[Spider/Legends|arachnids]] native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Biology and appearance==
Their fangs carried a strong but non-lethal poison. Several varieties of Arachne had the distinction of having ten legs.

==History==
{{Quote|This creature is far tougher and more massive than any of the other arachne.|[[Jana T'bayr]], about the [[Parasophic Arachne|queen's mate]]|<ref name="SWG:AB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Adaptive Biology|Talus}}</ref>}}
[[File:AdaptiveBiology-GH.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Spacers discovering the [[Parasophic Arachne|queen's mate]].]]
A breed of arachne known as [[bone gnasher]] was also known to inhabit the [[Krayt Cult Cave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] since they had been imported from Endor to Tatooine<ref name="JDW" /> by the [[Krayt Cult]]ists.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[GeneTech Syndicate]] carried out an illegal [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] program on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]] project, in order to create an intelligent and powerful form of arachne. Although the experiment was success, the bioengineered creatures overwhelmed their creators and slaughtered most of the [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]] staff. The situation was finally discovered by the [[Corellian Security Force]] and the arachnes were eradicated by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]].<ref name="SWG:G">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Genocide|Talus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', most of the gigantic Arachne spiders are defined as being an [[Angler/Legends|Angler]]. Yet the name is often misleading, because creatures such as the bone gnashers are defined as an Angler, despite being on Tatooine, where fishing for prey is virtually impossible.
